supersedes.reason: Production redeploy with a fresh deployer, a freshly generated backend signer, and a new owner. The previous deployment held 0 USDC and used the public signer key from api/.env.example.

arcNotes.nativeIsAliased: Same model as Arc testnet (deployments/5042002.json): native USDC and the 6-decimal ERC-20 at 0x3600...0000 are one balance. setNativeAliasToken(0x3600...) was called FIRST, which closes the native path; all value moves through the 6-decimal view. Mainnet USDC at 0x3600...0000 verified on-chain 2026-10-01: symbol()=USDC, decimals()=6.
arcNotes.gasIsUsdc: Gas is paid in native USDC from the sender's own balance. Clients must leave headroom for gas rather than offering a MAX-out-the-balance payment.

state.verifiedOnchain: 2026-10-11 via cast call: version()=2.1.0, owner()=0xc84d...2146, pendingOwner()=0x0, backendSigner()=0xAAE453E9...1D2C, nativeAliasToken()=USDC ERC-20, allowedPaymentTokens(USDC)=true, sweepCap(USDC)=1000000000, withdrawalDelay()=86400, ERC-1967 implementation slot = implementation above. Config verified on 2026-10-09 before the handover.
